You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"Evidence period: February 5\u201318, 2027\n\nUse: The corrected Lantern slice supported staff-only internal reference use. It produced 52 staff-only reference-card renders, including 19 cards carrying both owner-map and Cardinality Guardrails references. All 11 mapped metrics-router controls remained navigable to their authoritative records; Wes reached the authoritative pre-acceptance backpressure record without copying its value into Lantern. Iris found no wording that transferred authority to Lantern. Ownership remained separate: Lantern handled explanation and navigation, Cardinality Guardrails owned pipeline limits and cost semantics, the owner map owned published responsibility, and Product Engineering owned implementation.\n\nCustomer-path boundary: This evidence did not authorize customer exposure. Harbor Health and Mosaic Commerce each had zero internal-reference requests, artifacts, and outputs. The internal reference integration remained outside both customer paths."

CONTEXT: {"user_request": "Create a short evidence note for Lantern's February 5 to 18, 2027 internal reference slice, including its use and customer-path boundary.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Lantern February 5\u201318, 2027 internal reference slice \u2014 evidence note", "body": "Evidence period: February 5\u201318, 2027\n\nUse: The corrected Lantern slice supported staff-only internal reference use. It produced 52 staff-only reference-card renders, including 19 cards carrying both owner-map and Cardinality Guardrails references. All 11 mapped metrics-router controls remained navigable to their authoritative records; Wes reached the authoritative pre-acceptance backpressure record without copying its value into Lantern. Iris found no wording that transferred authority to Lantern. Ownership remained separate: Lantern handled explanation and navigation, Cardinality Guardrails owned pipeline limits and cost semantics, the owner map owned published responsibility, and Product Engineering owned implementation.\n\nCustomer-path boundary: This evidence did not authorize customer exposure. Harbor Health and Mosaic Commerce each had zero internal-reference requests, artifacts, and outputs. The internal reference integration remained outside both customer paths.", "folder": "Lantern"}, "field_being_checked": "result.document.body"}

CRITERION:
The note reports 52 staff-only reference-card renders, including 19 with both owner-map and Cardinality Guardrails references, and 11 of 11 mapped metrics-router controls remaining navigable. It says Wes reached the authoritative pre-acceptance backpressure record without copying its value into Lantern, Iris found no authority-transferring wording, and both Harbor Health and Mosaic Commerce had zero internal-reference requests, artifacts, and outputs. It does not present internal navigation as customer authorization or an authority transfer.

Return the JSON verdict now.
